areas.name: PC Route and Completion Plan

items.label: Do Not Use the Rewards Shortcut

levels.1: Earn permanent rewards through play for this archive run.
levels.2: Leave the All In-game Rewards Unlock purchase disabled.

levels.1: After each clear, revisit Story and look only for newly available route choices.
levels.2: Retain a completed result for every route variant that the Story menu reveals.
levels.3: Begin with either playable choice, preserve its result, clear the complementary Second Run that appears, then repeat from the other opening choice until every revealed variant has a saved result.

levels.1: The highest fixed difficulty has its own full-route profile goals.
levels.2: Earn a Hardcore result for every route variant currently shown in Story.
levels.3: Use Ink Ribbons for manual saves and work through every revealed First Run and complementary Second Run; confirm each Hardcore result remains on the same profile.

levels.1: Plan separate fast clears after learning each route.
levels.2: Earn Hardcore S+ for every route variant currently shown in Story.
levels.3: For each revealed variant, finish a First Run inside 2:30 or a Second Run inside 2:00, use no more than three manual saves, and avoid every infinite firearm; the infinite knife remains eligible.

areas.name: Main-Route Replay Rewards

levels.1: A profile-wide figure hunt grants a durable defensive weapon.

levels.1: A fast Standard clear opens the first infinite firearm.

levels.1: A fast Hardcore clear upgrades the automatic replay option.

levels.3: Clear either route within the correct Hardcore limit; S permits ordinary saves and previously earned equipment, then places the infinite LE 5 in every main-route item box.

levels.3: Finish Leon's First Run within 2:30 or Second Run within 2:00, make at most three manual saves, use no infinite firearm, and collect the ATM-4 from a later item box.

levels.1: The other playable route has a matching Hardcore speed reward.

levels.3: Finish Claire's First Run within 2:30 or Second Run within 2:00, make at most three manual saves, use no infinite firearm, and collect the Minigun from a later item box.
